## Scope Check — PR #74 (`feature/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches`, `54e924f` vs `origin/develop` `269d5d4`)

I re-derived everything below from `git diff origin/develop..HEAD` and the current file contents myself — I did not take `postbuild.md`'s self-audit at face value, and its central claim does not survive that check (see §6).

### 1. Full file inventory (17 files)

| File | Type | In plan manifest? |
|---|---|---|
| `.claude/registry/{components,hooks,pages}.md` | auto | churn, see §5 |
| `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` | MODIFY | yes |
| `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/{index.tsx,index.stories.tsx,index.test.tsx,zimmColourSwatch.css.ts}` | CREATE ×4 | yes |
| `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/{index.tsx,index.stories.tsx,index.test.tsx,zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts}` | CREATE ×4 | yes |
| `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts` | CREATE ×1 | **no** — see §6 |
| `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` | MODIFY | yes |
| `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` | MODIFY (Tier 2) | yes |
| `overrides/app/theme/foundation/colour.ts` | MODIFY (**Tier 1**) | **no — explicitly excluded** |
| `overrides/app/theme/foundation/zimmTokens.ts` | MODIFY (**Tier 1**) | **no — explicitly excluded** |

### 2. `product-view/index.tsx` blast radius — clean

Read the full file diff directly. The only changes are: the header-comment update (1→2 documented props), the new `renderVariationAttribute?` prop + its JSDoc (lines ~181–192), its destructure (line 298), extraction of the pre-existing inline `.map()` body into a same-named function `renderDefaultVariationAttribute` with **byte-identical** contents (including the untouched `variant={id === 'color' ? 'circle' : 'square'}` line and the pre-existing `audit-allow` comment), and the call-site swap to `{renderVariationAttribute?.(attr) ?? renderDefaultVariationAttribute(attr)}` (line 865) wrapped in `<React.Fragment key={attr.id}>`. Confirmed via `grep -rn "renderVariationAttribute"` that the prop has exactly one consumer in the whole repo — `product-detail/index.tsx:913` — so every other `<ProductView>` caller (the set/bundle parent at `product-detail/index.tsx:811`, the set/bundle child at `:837`, and the three base-package modules named in the file's own header comment) renders through the unchanged default path. This step delivered exactly what the plan specified, nothing else.

### 3. Tier check — hard violation found

- `overrides/app/theme/foundation/colour.ts:93` — adds `disabled: grey[200]` under `colors.icon`.
- `overrides/app/theme/foundation/zimmTokens.ts:84` — adds `'--zimm-color-icon-disabled': colors.icon.disabled`.

Both files are individually named in `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md`'s Design-System Tier-1 list and covered by AGENTS.md Hard Rule #3 ("Never modify `overrides/app/theme/foundation/`"). The token is consumed at `zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts:167` (`_disabled: { color: 'var(--zimm-color-icon-disabled)' }`, the pagination chevron's disabled state) — a real functional need, added in commit `0fe3c2d` and wired up in `0aff491`, both **after** the plan's originally-scoped 4-commit build (`9f46912`→`7139687`) had already completed.

Critically, this isn't just a general Tier-1 breach — it violates **this PR's own plan on the plan's own terms**. `plan.md` states, three separate times: "with zero change to ... `theme/foundation/`" (line 15), "**Excluded, absolute:** `theme/foundation/**` (Tier 1)" (line 79), and "**Hard stop (BLOCKED)** at any step if the diff touches `theme/foundation/`" (line 338). No carve-out for approver status is recorded anywhere in the plan's own decision log (§1b), unlike other scope decisions (e.g. Decision #4, #5) which *are* explicitly logged there.

I also ran the live verification AGENTS.md itself prescribes, for completeness: `gh api user --jq .login` → `marcelannavarro`; `gh api orgs/ZimmermannAU/teams/tier-1-approvers/members --jq '.[].login'` → includes `marcelannavarro`. So this specific edit was made by a genuinely verified Tier-1 approver, not an unauthorized identity — but per AGENTS.md's own wording that mechanism only "reduces how many times Claude pauses to ask," it doesn't retroactively make the file non-Tier-1, and it doesn't undo the plan's own absolute exclusion of this exact path.

**`overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (Tier 2)** — clean. Diff is exactly 2 new import lines + 2 new keys in the `components` map (`ZimmColourSwatch`, `ZimmColourSwatchGroup`), no new raw design values, nothing else touched. Registration-only, as planned.

### 4. AC-by-AC delivery (checked against current file contents, not the plan's claims)

- **AC1** (single colour → label only): `zimmColourSwatchGroup/index.tsx:99` filters to `populated` (image-present) values first; the swatch row + `role="radiogroup"` render only under `{populated.length > 1 && (...)}` (line 223). 0 or 1 populated colours → label row only. Test: `index.test.tsx:75`.
- **AC2/3** (one swatch per populated colour; selection indicated): `index.tsx:237–256` maps one `<ZimmColourSwatch>` per windowed value; `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts:36–42` gives `selected` a distinct bottom border off Figma node `40000307:13831`.
- **AC4** (URL updates, no full reload): `zimmColourSwatch/index.tsx:11` uses `chakra(RouteLink)` (react-router-dom), the same client-side-navigation primitive base SFCC's own swatch uses; `href` flows unmodified from SFCC's `attr.values[].href` (`product-detail/index.tsx:922`). The plan itself flags the "no full reload" half as unprovable below E2E and logs it as a deliberate, named gap (plan.md lines 53–56) rather than a silent drop — no `.feature`/Playwright spec was added, consistent with that log.
- **AC5** (unresolved image withheld): `index.tsx:99`'s filter keys on `imageUrl` alone, applied before both the AC1 count and the render loop. Tests at `index.test.tsx:93` and `:100` also assert the filter is image-only, not stock/orderability-based.

No over-delivery inside the AC logic itself — pagination is a plan-recorded, explicitly-approved addition (Decision #5), not a silent extra.

### 5. Registry churn — genuinely auto-generated

`.claude/registry/*.md` diffs carry a fresh `Last updated` timestamp each, preserve alphabetical ordering throughout, and the new `ZimmColourSwatch`/`ZimmColourSwatchGroup` rows land in correct alphabetical position with prop signatures pulled verbatim from the real source I read in §4. This is expected churn, not a finding. Worth noting as an aside only: a lot of the incidental churn (consumer-count drift and even swapped description text on entirely untouched base files like `ImageGallery`, `ShopperAgent`, `useMiaw`) looks like a determinism/extraction quirk in `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs` itself — outside this PR's scope to fix, and not evidence of hand-editing.

### 6. Manifest-count discrepancy — postbuild's self-audit does not hold up

`plan.md` §3 states "Create — 8 new files" and "Modify — exactly 3." The actual diff has:
- **9 CREATE files**, not 8 — the extra one is `zimmColourSwatchGroup/zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts` (introduced in commit `0aff491`, holding `SWATCHES_PER_PAGE = 4`). Not named anywhere in `plan.md` (checked via grep for `zimmColourSwatchGroupShared`/`SWATCHES_PER_PAGE`).
- **5 non-registry MODIFY files**, not 3 — the 2 extra are the Tier-1 foundation files in §3.

`postbuild.md`'s "All 8 CREATE + 3 MODIFY files match exactly" claim is contradicted by the diff itself — consistent with this session's other findings that prior self-audits don't survive independent re-derivation. Severity note: the shared-constant file alone is low-risk (same folder, same tier/owners as its already-approved siblings, added for a legitimate DRY reason) and I would not block on it in isolation; the two Tier-1 foundation files are the real problem.

---

## Verdict

**BLOCKED** — `overrides/app/theme/foundation/colour.ts:93` and `overrides/app/theme/foundation/zimmTokens.ts:84` are Tier 1 files, individually named in `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md`, and this PR's own plan (`plan.md` lines 15, 79–80, 338) declares `theme/foundation/**` "Excluded, absolute" and a named "Hard stop (BLOCKED)" condition. Both were modified anyway, in commit `0fe3c2d`, to support the pagination-chevron disabled-colour work added in `0aff491` — after the plan's originally-scoped 4-commit build had already closed. The edit was made by a live-verified `@ZimmermannAU/tier-1-approvers` member (`marcelannavarro`), which is relevant context for how the PR should be unblocked, but does not change the verdict: the plan itself, not just the general Tier-1 rule, forbids this path with no recorded exception.

Everything else in the PR — `product-view/index.tsx`'s slot, `theme/components/index.ts`'s registration, `product-detail/index.tsx`'s wiring, and all 5 ACs — is in scope and correctly delivered; the one unplanned low-tier file (`zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`) is a minor manifest-count miss, not a scope-tier violation.
